dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You're good, but I'm still a little better.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You're quite vigilant, and your tactics are impeccable.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Excuse me? Did you want something?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: It's so cold here...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Cold is the norm when you're up a mountain like this one.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: You look like a Traveler. So, are you planning on scaling the mountain?

dialogues.speaker: Traveler
dialogues.text: Just to have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Fair enough. I'm not going to try and stop you... I've met my fair share of travelers and whatever you say, there's no dissuading them.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: All I will say, if you're serious about this, is to keep an eye on your <color=#00E1FFFF>body temperature</color> at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: If your temperature drops too low, not only will it slow you down, but you can also injure yourself. And if you're unlucky enough to get attacked by a monster in that state... Well, that's the last situation you'd want to find yourself in.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: So, if your temperature drops dangerously low, get yourself to a <color=#00E1FFFF>source of heat</color> and warm back up while you plan your next move.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: In short, and I know you've probably heard this plenty of times, but it's true: This is, by far, the most dangerous place in all of Mondstadt. When you're climbing a mountain, you must always plan your movements carefully.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I've seen more than a few adventurers lose their lives because they didn't think before they acted...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Alright, I won't lecture you any longer. Just be sure to prepare before you set out.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this place very dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I would strongly caution against venturing into these parts on a whim.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Low temperatures, monsters, rugged terrain... Everything here is far more dangerous than one would imagine.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: ...Here are some of my notes from adventuring in Dragonspine. Take them with you — I trust that they'll be of some use.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Hmm? Is something the matter? Did you come here to see the sights, or did that boy Cyrus send you here on some commission?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: ...Well, whatever your reasons for being here may be, stay on your guard at all times.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what can you tell me about Dragonspine...

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Alfry from the Intelligence Department says that Dragonspine has some sort of connection with the evil dragon that fought Dvalin in the past, though none of that really interests me.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: As far as I'm concerned, this is just a place worth adventuring in.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: One thing to note is that this place is more dangerous than any other place in Mondstadt. In this extreme cold, your first priority must be maintaining your body temperature.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: ...Bravery and foolhardiness are not to be equated lightly here. It is best to proceed with a plan, lest you lose your life in vain.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That... boy, Cyrus?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Yes, Cyrus is my younger brother.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: We used to go on adventures together — you could say that we were quite the famous duo, too.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: But he's been tied down by all sorts of trivial matters ever since taking up the role of branch master of the Mondstadt Adventurers' Guild. We haven't traveled together in quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: I did receive an offer to become a Guild branch master myself, but I refused. As far as I'm concerned, it's much easier to be a regular adventurer.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're... his sister?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Yes. We actually look quite alike, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: As for why he looks like he's from Mondstadt while I look like I'm from Liyue... It's a long story. Something to do with our parents.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: ...Ho, do you mean to ask why I look younger than he does?

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: There's no big secret behind it. It's just a matter of maintenance and attention.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you, then.

dialogues.speaker: Iris
dialogues.text: Stay on your guard and don't get careless. Ad astra abyssosque!
